Taxi fares — Department of Land Transport rates effective January 2023 (B.E. 2566).

Sedan / van:
• First 1 km: 40 THB
• Km 2–10: 6.50/km
• Km 11–20: 7.00/km
• Km 21–40: 8.00/km
• Km 41–60: 8.50/km
• Km 61–80: 9.00/km
• Beyond 80 km: 10.50/km

Under 6 km/h: 3 THB/min. App/call booking +20 THB. DMK/BKK pickup +50 THB.

privacyBody:
This app uses only what it needs to sign you in and to run the features you open.

1. Data we use
Your email is used to send an OTP and identify your account. If you sign in with Google, we receive the email and name from that account. Location is used when you open Near alarm, Restroom, or Taxi fare.

2. How we use it
We use this data to verify who you are, save your settings, and show results for the features you use.

3. How it is stored
Account data is kept so you can come back later. You can sign out from the account page.
